test_title: PYST 12: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym for the underlined word in the given sentence.**

We cannot achieve success until these __**antiquated**__ policies are not amended.
solution: The correct answer is **"Outdated."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The underlined word **"antiquated" **means old-fashioned or outdated. (पुरातन, अप्रचलित, गतप्रयोग) • **Example**: *It will take many years to modernize these **antiquated**__ industries.* • The synonym for** "antiquated"** is **"outdated."** • It means no longer in use or out of date. (बेकार हो चुका, प्रचलन से बाहर; पुरानी चाल का) __ • **Example**: *Nowadays, this technique is completely **outdated**__.* • The sentence means that success cannot be achieved until old-fashioned policies are changed. • The correct answer is Option 1. **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** • **Option 2 (Current)** means present or existing now. (वर्तमानकालीन; इस समय प्रचलित) • **Option 3 (New)** means recently made or produced. (नया (बना, खोजा आदि)) • **Option 4 (Updated)** means brought up to date or modernized. (अद्यतन या आधुनिकीकरण किया गया) 30:T945, The correct answer is **"prudent."**
